name: Window Nativizer
description:
Brings Adwaita's corners and GPU-baked shadows, and GTK-width resize edges, to windows that draw their own frame (Qt, Electron, GTK3, Wine). Apps that already look native through libadwaita or libhandy are recognised by the libraries they map, and keep their corners and shadow. Where geometry cannot tell whether a window rounds its own corners, five alpha samples of its own texture decide, cached per window kind in the user cache directory.
Stored in GSettings: your rules, the title each was picked from (shown, never matched on), and two display preferences. Rules cross machines over the clipboard on request. The picker is a session-bus method any local process can call.
